environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule at priority 200 that applies a regex pattern set matching on query string parameters using a RegexPatternSet containing patterns for common SQL metacharacters including single-quote sequences, UNION keywords, and comment sequences (--), with action BLOCK and TextTransformation URL_DECODE applied, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via security group. CloudWatch Logs Insights query scheduled every 60s alerts on blocked requests but takes no automated action.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.waf_rule_priority_200: Custom rule, RegexPatternSet on QueryString with URL_DECODE transform, patterns: ["'[\s]*(?:OR|AND|UNION|SELECT)", "--", "'%", "(?i)union[\s]+select", "'\s*;\s*"], action: BLOCK
config.ecs_task_networking: awsvpc mode, security group allows egress only to ALB SG on port 443
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights scheduled query, alert-only, no auto-remediation
